leadText: Pokémon Adventures: Dratini Of The Deep is the 26th monthly issue released by VIZ Media of the Pokémon Adventures manga created by Hidenori Kusaka and Mato. It contains chapters 20, 21, and 22 of the . The chapters originally released in this book were later re-released as part of . As a bonus, it contained a sheet of Pokémon stickers which were not included with the collected volume release.
